_comment: Copy to www/config.json (gitignored — never commit a key). The player reads this at boot.

_streetview_help.mode: auto (js → stills → link) | js | stills | link. Per-browser override: localStorage['yy-sv-mode'].
_streetview_help.step_m: metres of drift before the walk hops to the next pano. Smaller = smoother and more Dynamic Street View panorama loads (billed); 12 ≈ every pano on a London street, 25 ≈ every other one.
_streetview_help.max_stills: hard cap on Street View Static frames per scene in the hyperlapse fallback (cost ceiling).
_streetview_help.resume_after_s: seconds of no touching before the auto-walk takes the camera back after a drag.
